   - **H2 (Flanking-orthologue recurrence)**: Attrition funnel counts (`2,838 -> 2,426 -> 2,378 -> 1,461 -> 353`), deterministic locus ranking, 16-stratum Mantel–Haenszel weights $n_K n_Q / (n_K + n_Q)$, positional null eligibility, seeds (`20261013`, `20261014`, `20261015`), within-arm excess recurrence (`31.75` and `25.67` percentage points, $p = 0.0002$), and inconclusive adjusted between-group contrasts ($\Delta_{\mathrm{MH}} = 0.035358$, $p = 0.4069$; `-0.54` percentage points across `96` strict pairs, $p = 0.9226$) are verified and properly bounded.
   - **H3 (Matched SMAG vs GEM reference search)**: Deterministic seed replay (`20261014`–`20261016`; `1` fixed SMAG draw of `1,500/40,039` genomes and `3` GEM draws of `2,055/52,515` genomes), `373` Zenodo MD5 checksums, `25,067` pre-matching vs `22,310` post-matching shared sequences (`4,210,592` vs `4,185,525` proteins per arm), all 16 census rows and 80 length-stratified rows (`+18.54` percentage points primary dark-query difference vs `+3.10` points for controls), and completed raw IBEX audit (`job 53796328`) are verified and framed as finite-catalogue coverage comparisons.
   - **H4 (Paired PDB structural search and Figure 4)**: Defective alignment-normalised TM-scores are excluded from biological endpoints; query-normalised TM-score ($\text{qTM} \ge 0.5$) results for the pooled `1,031`-model low-query-score dark cohort (`67` WC-matched and `964` WC-unmatched on CPU, with `714/964` [74.07%] recovered by cropping and `775/1,031` [75.17%] crop-matched overall; `731/961` and `794/1,031` on GPU), the `1,807` other dark models (`1,408` WC and `1,578` crop matches, split into `1,107` initial PDB matches [`1,107` WC, `1,009` crop] and `700` initial AFDB-only matches [`301` WC, `569` crop]), and the `3,013` controls across CPU (`2,878` WC; `2,889`, `2,842`, `2,823`, `2,796` crop) and GPU (`2,896`, `2,816`, `2,788`, `2,753` crop) tiers, as well as the CPU `alntmscore > 1` row-exclusion audit (`0` changes in Tier 1; `4` WC and `9` crop control models in Tiers 2–4), are verified and framed as a joint intervention on sequence extent, length-dependent score normalisation, and retrieval opportunity.
